That suggests "bulk" may mean scripting many single calls rather than native batch operations. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints or a bulk UI with item-level semantics, evidence that the MCP/AI agent can act on many items at once, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

Custom Tests (vanta-docs-2) produce pass/fail evidence rather than triggering actions, and the generic claims about automated reminders and workflows (vanta-docs-22) are adjacent marketing statements, not configurable rules.

Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows, user-configurable schedules or cadences, API/MCP access to create schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
